data.name: Phylis
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Phylis was a woman who fell in love with the god Apollo disguised as a mortal. The name Phylis is derived from the Greek word 'philos' meaning 'friend' or 'lover', and 'hippos' meaning 'horse'. Phylis' deep love for horses was so strong that she dedicated her life to them.
